{{Quote|We don't seem to be getting through to these ''Lahsbees'' at all, ''See-Threepio.'' Are you sure you're translating everything I say correctly?"<br />"Absolutely, ''Master Luke!'' They quite readily admit that one of the missing Rebel pilots we're searching for&mdash;''Yom Argo''&mdash;crashlanded and died here on Lahsbane.|Luke Skywalker and C-3PO|<ref name="M73" />}}
'''Lahsbane''' was a planet located in the [[Onatos sector/Legends|Onatos sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], that served as the home for the [[Lahsbee/Huhk|Lahsbee and Huhk]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;the small and peaceful Lahsbee, who lived in Lahsbane's forests, inevitably grew into the large and aggressive Huhk in the planet's cities. Remote and resource-poor, Lahsbane was left uncharted until an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] expedition happened across the world sometime before [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Yom Argo]] crashed and [[Death/Legends|died]] on Lahsbane.

==Description==
{{Quote|Artoo says that the air here is filled with a very fine pollen... which has clogged all the intake valves.|C-3PO, to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="M73" />}}
[[File:Lahsbane.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The surface of Lahsbane]]
A remote, resource-poor<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Onatos sector/Legends|Onatos sector]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Lahsbane was a planet of forests and river canyons, and was home to the [[Lahsbee/Huhk|Lahsbee]], a small furry [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived within Lahsbane's tall grasses. However, Lahsbees eventually grew into a tall, aggressive race called the Huhks, which lived apart from their juvenile counterparts in the more modern [[The Forbidden City|Forbidden City]]. Lahsbee's forest air carried a large amount of very fine pollen, which was known to clog [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="M73" />

==History==
{{Quote|Yom Argo never made it back to the fleet. He was shot down on Lahsbane.|Leia Organa|<ref name="M77">[[Star Wars (1977) 77|''Star Wars'' (1977) 77]]</ref>}}
The Huhk had attained a somewhat more sophisticated urban society by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], while the juvenile Lahsbees made the choice to actively resist advanced technology and still traversed the Lahsbane's vast river canyons on balloons.<ref name="M73" /> As its region was considered remote and difficult to traverse, Lahsbane was only first charted during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], by an Imperial expedition.<ref name="AA" /> Lahsbane was briefly touched by the war in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Yom Argo]], fleeing Imperial pursuit after retrieving [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] intelligence on a new Imperial [[Death Star II/Legends|superweapon]], crash-landed and [[Death/Legends|died]] on the planet. Argo's disappearance led Rebel leadership to dispatch a team helmed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to Lahsbane to ascertain Argo's fate and retrieve the intelligence, and they were ultimately forced to retrieve Argo's [[Data-tape/Legends|datatapes]] from the Forbidden City, fighting off a rampaging horde of Huhks.<ref name="M73" /> Lahsbane ultimately became an early joiner of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="M94">[[Star Wars (1977) 94|''Star Wars'' (1977) 94]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Different sources have conflicted on Lahsbane's precise location&mdash;while ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and subsequent maps place Lahsbane in the Mid Rim,<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[Alien Anthology]]'' indicates that it was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], near [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="AA" />
